en-US.title: Venture: History Nearby
en-US.subtitle: The history all around you
en-US.promoText: Wherever you stand you are surrounded by history. Venture makes all of it visible in seconds: the famous, the forgotten, and the stories you never knew were there.
en-US.description:
Venture brings you the history around you.

Stand almost anywhere in this country and there are centuries within a few minutes' walk. Buildings that have been standing for three hundred years. Streets named after whatever happened on them. Places where something extraordinary took place and nothing marks it at all.

Open the app and all of it is in front of you, closest first, each with a photograph. Tap any of it and the story follows: about a minute to read, or to listen to while you carry on walking. No searching, no setting up, no account.

Some of what you find you will half know already, and Venture gives you a good deal more of it than the sign outside: the full account in chapters, with a timeline and whatever else happened on the same ground. The rest you will be meeting for the first time. A prison that stood for two centuries. A palace that burned down. A nuclear reactor that ran in Greenwich until 1996.

When something catches your eye, the answer is already waiting. When you would rather go and see it, Venture takes you there, by compass or by turn-by-turn directions.

Keep whatever you like and it works without a signal. Or look a place up before you go: the city you are visiting next month, the street you grew up on.

• Everything historic within a walk, nearest first, each with a photograph
• A telling of about a minute for every place, to read or to listen to
• Longer stories in chapters, with timelines, for towns and neighborhoods
• Compass and turn-by-turn walking directions to anything you pick
• Saved stories work offline
• No account, no ads, nothing following you around

Your location stays on your phone, where it sorts what is nearby and points the compass.
